theme: Rental listing scrapers and datasets (Craigslist, Zillow rentals, Apartments.com, Idealista, Rightmove, Zoopla, Immoscout24, SeLoger, Immobiliare, Domain, realestate.com.au)
note_on_method: WebSearch tool was exhausted session-wide before any query for this scout could run (shared 200-call budget across concurrent scouts). All findings below come from WebFetch on GitHub topic pages (github.com/topics/<tag>) and direct repo pages instead of search-engine queries. Coverage is therefore biased toward whatever GitHub's own topic-tag index surfaces, not full-text search across READMEs/blogs/Kaggle/Zenodo as the brief intended. This is a methodological limitation to flag to the orchestrator, not a finding of absence -- a rerun with WebSearch available would likely find more, especially non-GitHub-topic-tagged academic replication packages and Kaggle/Zenodo pointers.

candidates.name: flathunter
candidates.what_it_holds: Python/Docker bot that scrapes live listings from ImmoScout24, Immowelt, WG-Gesucht, Kleinanzeigen (Germany), Idealista, Immobiliare, Subito (Italy/Spain) and pushes new-listing alerts via Telegram/Slack/Mattermost/Apprise. No historical data committed; keeps only a processed_ids.db to dedupe. AGPL-3.0, 1,100+ stars, 1,183 commits, actively maintained.
candidates.why_useful: A single maintained multi-platform LTR scraper covering DE/IT/ES markets could be run periodically (by a human, terms-of-service permitting) to build a point-in-time LTR-asking-rent panel for host-supply-economics analysis (gap 13). Not itself a dataset.
candidates.last_activity: actively maintained (commit count high, recent forks/stars growth noted)

candidates.name: open-properties
candidates.what_it_holds: CLI/MCP-server/AI-agent-skill tool normalizing live queries across 9 providers in 9 countries: Rightmove/Zoopla/ESPC (UK), Daft.ie (Ireland), ImmoScout24 (Germany), RentCast (US), REALTOR.ca DDF (Canada), Domain (Australia), Idealista (Spain/Italy/Portugal). Queries live APIs, does not persist a dataset; some providers need API keys, three (Rightmove, Daft.ie, ImmoScout24) work anonymously. MIT license, 27 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Broadest single multi-country LTR aggregation tool found; could be scheduled to build a point-in-time cross-country asking-rent panel (gap 13) without maintaining separate scrapers per country.
candidates.geography: UK, Ireland, Germany, US, Canada, Australia, Spain, Italy, Portugal

candidates.name: HomeHarvest
candidates.what_it_holds: Python package scraping Realtor.com (primary) plus a Zillow RapidAPI path; supports for_rent, for_sale, sold, pending listing types; exports to CSV/Excel/pandas/Pydantic/JSON. MIT license, 739 stars, 288 commits.
candidates.why_useful: One-command pull of current US rental asking-price listings by metro from Realtor.com; usable to build a point-in-time LTR panel for host-supply-economics / STR<->LTR crossover work (gap 13). No historical data bundled -- would need to be run repeatedly going forward, so cannot backfill.

candidates.name: zoopla (Python wrapper)
candidates.what_it_holds: Thin Python wrapper around the (now largely defunct/restricted) Zoopla API, described as giving access to '27m homes, over 1m sale and rental listings, and 15 years of sold price data' when the API was open. No data committed; 89 stars, only 5 commits.
candidates.why_useful: Low value now since Zoopla closed most of its public API; kept for completeness as a UK rental-data acquisition method if API access is restored.
candidates.last_activity: unclear, low commit count suggests stale

candidates.name: rightmove_webscraper.py
candidates.what_it_holds: Python class returning up to 1,050 live Rightmove.co.uk listings (price, property type, address, bedrooms, postcode, agent) per search as a pandas DataFrame. No committed dataset. MIT license, 282 stars, 119 forks, 83 commits. Repo itself flags that Rightmove's ToS prohibits scraping.
candidates.why_useful: Simple one-command live pull of UK asking rents/sale prices by postcode/region for LTR supply-economics work (gap 13); ToS caveat means any use is a human terms-of-service call per repo CLAUDE.md rule 6.
candidates.last_activity: moderate (83 commits, exact date not surfaced)

candidates.name: Saudi-Real-Estate-Data
candidates.what_it_holds: 4.93M real-estate transactions from Saudi Ministry of Justice (MOJ) and REGA, 2018-2025, covering sales, mortgages, seizures AND rentals across 13 regions of Saudi Arabia. Jupyter Notebook repo, 10 stars, last updated ~22 May 2026.
candidates.why_useful: A large, multi-year, government-sourced committed rental+sales transaction dataset outside the US/EU (APAC/MENA gap adjacent); could proxy Gulf-region housing/rental cost trends relevant to a fast-growing ABNB market (Saudi/Gulf tourism), though not a direct STR proxy.
candidates.license: not stated in summary; verify on repo

candidates.name: apartments-com-listings-scraper-python
candidates.what_it_holds: Python scraper for Apartments.com claiming '90+ property details & manager emails' and an 'Akamai bypass'; no committed data, 0 stars, last updated 16 May 2026.
candidates.why_useful: One-command pull of US multifamily rental listings for host-supply-economics work (gap 13); low maturity/no track record, and the explicit anti-bot-bypass framing raises a ToS flag per rule 6.

candidates.name: domain-scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Node.js scraper for domain.com.au rental listings with Docker support and CSV export; 15 stars, last updated 20 Jul 2026. No committed historical data.
candidates.why_useful: One-command pull of Australian rental asking prices; could support APAC housing/LTR-supply comparisons (touches gaps 7 and 13 indirectly).

candidates.name: api-immo-scrapper-leboncoin-pap
candidates.what_it_holds: Scrapy-based API scraping SeLoger, LeBonCoin and PAP (three major French property/classifieds sites) for listings; 72 stars. No committed dataset seen from topic listing; exact owner/repo path not resolved in this pass (topic-page summary only).
candidates.why_useful: Broadest French LTR listing source combining 3 sites in one tool; useful for France host-supply-economics work (gap 13). Needs a direct repo verification to confirm data_kind and license (not done this pass -- flag for follow-up).
candidates.last_activity: unverified (seen only via topic page, not direct repo fetch)

candidates.name: mcp-fairrent
candidates.what_it_holds: MCP server wrapping HUD housing data APIs: Fair Market Rents (FMR), Section 8 income limits, and a USPS ZIP-to-jurisdiction crosswalk. TypeScript, 0 stars, last updated 12 Sep 2026 (2 days before this scout).
candidates.why_useful: Directly matches CONTEXT.md gap 13's explicit call-out of 'HUD FMR' -- a live, current, one-call method to pull official US fair-market-rent benchmarks by ZIP/jurisdiction, useful for host-supply-economics and regional cost-of-living cross-checks. Government source (HUD), not scraped -- no ToS concern.
candidates.size_hint: code only, wraps a public government API
candidates.time_coverage: current HUD FMR vintage (annual, published by HUD)
candidates.geography: United States (all ZIP codes / FMR areas)

candidates.name: hud (API Evangelist HUD documentation)
candidates.what_it_holds: Documentation/catalogue (not a live client) of HUD's public API surface: Fair Market Rents, income limits, and other housing-affordability APIs, pointing to HUD's own developer portal (data.hud.gov). Last updated 12 Sep 2026, 0 stars.
candidates.why_useful: A map of which HUD housing APIs exist and their endpoints, useful for building a proper FMR puller directly against HUD's own API rather than relying on a third-party MCP wrapper. Supports gap 13.

candidates.url: https://github.com/topics/rental-prices (multiple small repos: Bali Rental Market Data, Dublin Rent Predictor)
candidates.name: Bali Rental Market Data / Dublin Rent Predictor (topic-page finds, not directly verified)
candidates.what_it_holds: Bali Rental Market Data: described on GitHub topic page as an open 'monthly dataset of median rents and villa sale prices per Bali area,' CC BY 4.0 licensed. Dublin Rent Predictor: uses official Irish RTB (Residential Tenancies Board) government rent data, claims 74% prediction accuracy. Neither repo's exact owner/path was confirmed by direct fetch in this pass (404s on my two owner guesses) -- follow-up scout should resolve exact URLs via search, which was unavailable to me.
candidates.why_useful: Bali is a top ABNB APAC leisure market; a committed monthly median-rent/villa-price series there is a rare non-US/EU LTR data point that could proxy local housing-cost/STR-conversion pressure (gap 13, touches gap 7 APAC). Dublin Rent Predictor repackages Ireland's official RTB rent index, a point-in-time government series (gap 13/4).
candidates.size_hint: unknown row counts; described only via topic-page summary
candidates.time_coverage: Bali: unspecified monthly window; Dublin: current RTB vintage

candidates.name: aptscraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Multi-platform scraper pulling live apartment listings from Kijiji and Craigslist (Canada/US classifieds). 0 stars, last updated 14 Sep 2024. No committed data.
candidates.why_useful: One of the few tools found still explicitly targeting Craigslist rentals (most Craigslist-topic repos are generic classifieds scrapers, not rental-specific); could be adapted for a point-in-time Craigslist rental-ask panel in US/Canada metros (gap 13). Stale (no 2025-26 commits).

candidates.name: craigslist_rental_listing_scraper
candidates.what_it_holds: Selenium + BeautifulSoup scraper explicitly framed as 'real estate-focused' / market-analysis tool for Craigslist rental listings. 0 stars, last updated 16 Apr 2024. No committed dataset found.
candidates.why_useful: Rental-specific (not generic classifieds) Craigslist scraper -- most direct match to the theme's Craigslist keyword hint, but stale and undocumented beyond the topic-page description; would need direct repo verification (not done this pass) before relying on its output schema.

candidates.name: BrightCat-Overview
candidates.what_it_holds: Overview repo for a commercial data product tracking '5.8M+ residential and 297K+ commercial properties weekly since 2014' including rentals, sold, and pre-mover data, delivered via Snowflake Marketplace and an MCP connector -- not a GitHub-hosted dataset itself, just a pointer/marketing repo. 0 stars, last updated 16 Apr 2026.
candidates.why_useful: If Snowflake Marketplace access is free/low-cost this could be a very large long-run (2014+) US property/rental panel, but it is a paid commercial product behind Snowflake, not an open dataset -- flagging only as a pointer for a human to evaluate cost.
candidates.size_hint: 5.8M residential + 297K commercial properties, weekly since 2014 (per vendor claim, unverified)

notes: CRITICAL PROCESS NOTE: the shared WebSearch tool budget (200 calls/session) was already exhausted by other concurrent scout agents before I ran a single query, so this scout could not do site:github.com queries, Kaggle/Zenodo/HuggingFace discovery, or awesome-list searches as instructed -- everything here comes from WebFetch on GitHub's own /topics/<tag> pages plus direct repo-page fetches, which only surfaces repos that have been explicitly topic-tagged (many relevant repos likely exist untagged and were invisible to this method). The orchestrator should either rerun this theme once WebSearch quota resets, or accept this as a partial pass. Dead ends: github.com/topics/zori, /rent-index, /craigslist-housing, /craigslist-data, /realestate-com-au, /flathunter all return zero tagged repos (the tag simply isn't used, not proof nothing exists). Idealista/Rightmove/Zoopla/ImmoScout24/SeLoger ecosystems are dominated by live-API-wrapper and personal-apartment-hunting-bot repos (no committed historical datasets) -- consistent with these sites' anti-scraping ToS suppressing public data dumps. The one genuinely promising sub-area is HUD Fair Market Rent tooling (gap 13's explicit ask), both surfaced. No repo found that is a substantial multi-year COMMITTED dataset for any of the named EU/UK/AU sites; if such exists it is likely on Kaggle/Zenodo rather than GitHub-topic-tagged, which this pass could not search for directly. Recommend a follow-up scout specifically targeting Kaggle/Zenodo/Dataverse for 'Rightmove sold prices', 'Idealista Madrid/Barcelona listings dataset', 'Zillow ZORI observed rent index history', and 'Craigslist rental panel academic'.
